concerns.text: FR-001 (load resting‑state fMRI data from ABCD Study or HCP‑Adolescents) is not covered by any task. The only real‑data related task is T014, which is a stub that never downloads or validates the required dataset, leaving the mandatory real‑data ingestion clause unmet.

FR-011 (validate the full analysis pipeline on real data using permutation testing) has no corresponding task. T014 is a placeholder that merely writes an “unavailable” status and does not perform the required validation, so the specification’s real‑data validation requirement is unaddressed.
